draft.goal: Bounded 4K JPEG/PNG full-frame WIC output verification with an independent streaming oracle under DC-MP-IMG2; no capability or memory promotion.

tasks.goal: Decode both 4K matched-raster inputs full-frame (no ROI), verify all 16,777,216 output pixels per output against the fixed coordinate formula, compare JPEG/PNG canonical RGBA, and refuse the 4095 bound before OnLoad, twice on one pinned source.

inputs.description: Verbatim W13 directive at docs/development/evidence-published/w13-latest/tern-directive.txt; start head 1b0af00e is the pushed W12 disposition.
DC-MP-IMG2 plus existing W2 worker, W6 sampler, W7 full-frame output/streaming PNG reader, W11 JPEG fixtures/oracle and W12 PNG fixture/matched oracle.

constraints.text: Only new w13_* runner/verifier/tests and w13-latest evidence plus minimal plan/BUILD_AND_RUN/TESTING updates. No WIC probe change, no new fixture generator, no dependency/unsafe/FFI/COM/GPU/Runtime/product API, no accepted-file rewrite.

Reuse the W11 4K DC-only JPEG and W12 streamed PNG byte-for-byte with their recorded digests. Verify every output pixel row-by-row against level(bx,by)=48+20*((3*bx+5*by+(bx^by)) mod 9); expected RGBA (level,level,level,255). Never use decoder output as expectation and never hold a full RGBA array.

4096 dimension, 16777216 pixels, 8 depth, 67108864 decoded/scratch; 16MiB input, 8MiB output, 32MiB report, 128MiB work, four workers per repeat, 45s worker/300s batch, 64KiB capture, 128KiB/128-record trace, 768MiB observed private. Refuse rather than raise a cap; a cap overrun is HOLD.

Reuse the W6 sampler at the same after_onload boundary. Whole-process counters from independent lifetimes only; no same-process delta, WIC-only memory, scratch peak, reservation, concurrent peak, codec advantage, latency benchmark or product SLO.

Taskern packet; pinned Native source and two fresh repeats; all Gate-declared outputs fixed before the candidate; nine finite Gates within the 600s producer ceiling on one candidate digest; failed Gates retained; successful-only disposal with before/after native verify; commit, explicit dev:dev push and exact remote SHA before Tern; PASS0/0/0 then docs-only limited disposition.

outputs.description: W13 full-frame streaming oracle/verifier, four-case matrix and hermetic/semantic negative tests.
Two fresh four-case/ eight-lifetime real Windows records with retained full-frame PNG bytes, canonical RGBA digests, admission stages and whole-process windows.
Quality/regressions, nine committed-candidate Gates, artifact correspondence, successful-only disposal integrity, pushed Tern review and limited disposition.

acceptance.statement: A01/A02: both fixtures regenerate byte-identically and all 16,777,216 input pixels of each are independently equal to the fixed coordinate formula.
A03/A04/A05: both 4K inputs pass full-frame admission and a complete OnLoad-to-publish stage sequence; each output PNG structure and inflation is bounded.
A06/A07: every pixel of both outputs matches the expected expression and the JPEG/PNG canonical RGBA agree on all pixels, with first-mismatch coordinates retained on failure.
A08/A09/A10: S03/S04 refuse before OnLoad with no valid output, and every worker keeps consistent identity, trace, exit and reaping.
A11/A18: memory stays whole-process observation only and no unmeasured capability is promoted.
A12/A14: two repeats agree on sources, outputs and oracle results, and portable replay never claims Git source closure.
A15/A16/A17: strict W1-W12 regression is preserved, no probe/product behaviour changed, and every declared Gate artifact matches the committed candidate.

Nine finite Gates share one candidate digest, failed attempts are retained, disposal preserves integrity, and commit plus explicit dev push with exact remote-SHA confirmation precede the bounded Tern verdict.

evaluation.requirement: Hermetic/negative tests plus two real Windows matrices; streaming all-pixel oracle, PNG structural bounds, admission stages and whole-process windows.

Installed Taskern prepare, unchanged quality/regressions, nine Gates within producer limits, frozen declared outputs, integrity-bounded disposal, explicit push and remote SHA before a clean Tern verdict.
